Definition: Hoshajah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Hoshajah is the name of two Israelites. In Nehemiah 12:32, the text says "And after them went Hoshaiah."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Hoshajah matters because God knows His people by name, and Hoshajah is one of them.
RelatedEvents: The Dedication of Jerusalem's Wall; The Remnant Flees to Egypt
